# FilePage

**PPL language/runtime 4.00 - host object.**

[Object model and calling conventions](../objects.md) | [API index](index.md)

A bounded Directory.Find result with Entries, NextAfter and HasMore. Valid distinguishes an empty successful page from failure.

[Behavior, constraints and examples](../../../new_ppl.md#filebase-search-400).

## Entries

`FilePage.Entries: FileEntry[]`

Read-only instance property.

Read-only page. Entries contains at most 100 FILEENTRY values. NextAfter is passed to the same directory and query; HasMore means more index rows, not necessarily more matches. Valid=FALSE indicates failure. Pages are live reads, not a cross-call database snapshot.
